clue.text: Spout in a less rich tone

indicators.note: 'in a ... tone' says the words between are to be judged by how they are spoken
a tone of voice, so the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: less rich means poorer

explanation.surface: A request to speak in a humbler, less plummy voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a ... tone' wraps 'less rich' (POORER) and asks for its sound, which gives the identical-sounding POURER.
explanation.definitionFit: A spout is the thing a liquid is tipped out through, as is a jug's lip.

clue.text: Court in a half-hearted way?

definitions.meaning: an open central courtyard of a Roman house or modern building
the heart has two upper chambers bearing this name, so each is half of the heart's top

explanation.surface: Wooing someone without much enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a central open hall in architecture and an upper chamber of the heart in anatomy.

clue.text: The pencil needs sharpening-so do one's wits!

definitions.text: The pencil needs sharpening-so do one's wits!

parts.words: The pencil needs sharpening-so do one's wits!
parts.note: a blunt pencil literally lacks its tip, and a dull mind fails to grasp what is meant

explanation.surface: A gibe that someone's brain is as blunt as their pencil.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for failing to understand an argument also literally describes a blunt pencil.

clue.text: Second only to dining it is a problem for restauranteurs

parts.note: dining means eating

explanation.surface: A restaurant owner's worry list, where placing guests ranks just behind the food.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging where diners sit at tables is a perennial headache for anyone running a restaurant.

clue.text: Park notice warning against reporting to police

definitions.meaning: a sign telling people not to walk on the lawn
to grass is British slang for informing on someone to the police

explanation.surface: A sign in a park, or a criminal's threat to a would-be informer.
explanation.definitionFit: Literal lawn sign, and also a warning not to inform, since grass is slang for an informer.

clue.text: Water pistol used for shady purposes

definitions.text: Water pistol used for shady purposes

parts.words: Water pistol used for shady purposes
parts.note: reads like a crook's toy, but means a paint-spraying tool used for shading in artwork

explanation.surface: A child's toy squirter put to some underhand use.
explanation.definitionFit: An airbrush-style tool squirts liquid paint and is used to create shading.

clue.text: Keep jam

definitions.meaning: to keep is to save or maintain

explanation.surface: A terse instruction to hold on to the jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Both: to maintain something unspoiled, and a fruit conserve in a jar.

clue.text: Penitent continued briefly with religious ceremony

parts.note: cont. is the short form of continued
a rite is a religious ceremony

explanation.surface: A sinner who keeps attending a service of repentance.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone feeling sorry for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Trading item which comes from maritime town

parts.note: ex means from, as in ex-works
a port is a town on the sea

explanation.surface: Goods shipped out of a seaside harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods sold abroad are traded overseas.

clue.text: I pronounced myself in favour

indicators.note: spoken aloud, so the word is judged by its sound

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone declaring their own support in a vote.
explanation.definitionFit: The word used to vote yes in parliament means in favour.

clue.text: Coach group comprising a group of coaches

parts.note: to coach is to train
a set is a group

explanation.surface: A sports team of trainers containing a busload.
explanation.definitionFit: A toy railway is a collection of carriages, and carriages are coaches.

clue.text: Softly to lift one's voice in worship

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for softly
to lift one's voice is to raise it

explanation.surface: A hymn instruction to sing quietly in church.
explanation.definitionFit: Worship and glorification of God are close synonyms.

clue.text: Notable feature of one with a beer-gut

definitions.meaning: a notable is an eminent person

definitions.text: feature of one with a beer-gut
definitions.meaning: a protruding belly makes the body's shape stick out

explanation.surface: A pot belly being the most distinctive thing about a drinker.
explanation.definitionFit: An eminent person, and literally a body shape that sticks out.

clue.text: Appeal to the queen engenders a measure of resistance

parts.note: O is an appealing cry, as in 'O Lord'
HM is Her Majesty

explanation.surface: A plea to the monarch producing defiance.
explanation.definitionFit: The unit of electrical resistance.

clue.text: Fifty one thousand favourites are simply hangers on

parts.note: L is Roman fifty
I is Roman one
M is Roman thousand
pets are favourites

explanation.surface: Thousands of darlings dismissed as mere hangers-on.
explanation.definitionFit: These shellfish cling to rocks, a pun on clinging people.

clue.text: Sarcastic way to press one small American state

parts.note: to press clothes is to iron them
I is one
Cal is the shortened form of California

explanation.surface: A mocking route to squeeze a tiny state.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying the opposite of what is meant, as mockery does.

clue.text: Rule out the middle note in a musical composition

indicators.note: the note is placed inside the composition

parts.note: a prelude is a musical piece
middle C is the central note on a piano

explanation.surface: A music lesson about a central note in a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevent or make impossible.

clue.text: He found Livingstone in the Falklands

definitions.meaning: the journalist who greeted the missing explorer with 'Dr Livingstone, I presume?'
Port of this name is the islands' capital

explanation.surface: An explorer apparently tracking down Livingstone in the South Atlantic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Welsh-American journalist-explorer, and the capital of the Falkland Islands.

clue.text: Floral tribute from a little isle

indicators.note: the letters come from inside the words

explanation.surface: A garland given on a tiny island.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hawaiian garland of flowers is given as a greeting or honour.

clue.text: Like a deck that is rigged and loaded high

definitions.text: Like a deck that is rigged
definitions.meaning: a pack of cards secretly arranged to cheat
piled up in a tall heap

explanation.surface: A cheat's card pack piled up on the table.
explanation.definitionFit: Cards fixed for cheating, and things piled one on another.

clue.text: He let rice powder substitute go more cheaply

indicators.note: these letters are swapped round into a replacement order

explanation.surface: A man allowing a cheaper powder in place of rice.
explanation.definitionFit: Charging less made goods go for less money.

clue.text: Welsh woman novelist takes me in with simple poetry

indicators.note: 'takes ... in' means the novelist's name surrounds the next word
completes 'takes ... in', placing one word inside another

parts.note: Jean Rhys, novelist of Welsh descent, author of Wide Sargasso Sea
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Welsh writer admitting the speaker into her verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Jingles and nursery verses are basic versification.

clue.text: Pair up to hearten a merry old soul

indicators.note: to put into the heart of, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Old King Cole was a merry old soul in the nursery rhyme
taken as written

explanation.surface: Cheering up a jolly old man.
explanation.definitionFit: Two of something make a twosome.

clue.text: Retreat back to a Venetian island

indicators.note: going back means the word for retreat is read from its last letter to its first

parts.note: a lair is a retreat or den
taken as written

explanation.surface: Heading back to an island in Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The district by the famous bridge over Venice's Grand Canal was once an island.

clue.text: Do help clear the place of paralytic drunks

definitions.meaning: to do a task is to perform it

definitions.text: help clear the place of paralytic drunks
definitions.meaning: drunks too legless to walk must be borne out

explanation.surface: Bouncers removing comatose drinkers from a bar.
explanation.definitionFit: To perform or execute, and literally to bear people outside.

clue.text: Well-that's what it's kept in

parts.note: 'Well' reads as a hesitant opener, but is a pot holding writing fluid on a desk

explanation.surface: A shrug of an answer about where something is stored.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing fluid sits in a desk well.

clue.text: Bequeath in a touching way?

definitions.meaning: with a palm placed upon, as in laying on of palms

explanation.surface: Leaving something in a will in a sentimental manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass down to the next generation, and literally with a palm resting on something.

clue.text: The wind that somehow set in early

indicators.note: in some way, so these letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A breeze arriving ahead of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A breeze blowing from the direction of sunrise.
